title: Avoid app-specific appearance settings

statement.en: Avoid offering an app-specific appearance setting.
statement.ja: app独自のappearance settingを提供しない。

conditions: Respect the systemwide appearance choice so people don't need to adjust multiple settings or mistake the app for being unresponsive.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Dark Mode experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDark Modeの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
